FitnessBalance requests read-only access to steps, sleep sessions, heart-rate records, exercise sessions and active-calorie records. It reads these only during a sync you initiate, to show daily steps, recent sleep duration, recorded heart-rate summaries and a separate recent workout history. It requests no background or historical-access permission.

Only summaries, their time windows and a rolling seven-day exercise-session cache are saved in private, account-specific storage on this device, excluded from Android backup. Raw step, sleep and heart-rate records are not retained. Imported workout metadata includes its Health Connect ID, source app, activity type/title, start/end times and last modification time. Routes, notes, heart-rate samples and exercise segments are not imported. Active-calorie records are read to match complete, non-overlapping intervals from the same source app to an exercise session; daily totals and total-energy records are never substituted. Workouts have a separate account-isolated private cache. Sync does not upload them. Only when you select Record this workout and confirm, session metadata, elapsed duration and available active calories are saved to your Firebase account activity log and included once in daily totals. Missing calories stay unavailable and excluded from totals. Confirmed sessions of at least five elapsed minutes can earn calorie-independent XP, daily quests, weekly workout credit and general consistency achievements. Wearable base XP and weekly credit are capped at one qualifying session per workout date; saved award receipts prevent repeat claims. The app does not write to Health Connect or send health data to analytics.

The caches are refreshed by sync or removed using “Remove local health data”. Uninstalling the app also removes the local caches. Removing local data or revoking access does not delete workouts you explicitly saved to Firebase; delete those from your activity log. Revoked data types are hidden and removed from the cache when access is next checked. Revoking Health Connect permission does not itself delete the original records from their source apps.

You can grant only the data types you choose and manage or revoke access in Health Connect. Without permission or source records, summaries remain unavailable. Food and exercise logging continue independently. Imported summaries never change calorie goals, nutrient targets or XP. With your separate opt-in on the Exercise page, fresh sleep summaries can suggest a shorter existing workout. The comparison baseline uses at least three previous comparable recorded days; source records may be incomplete. Baseline observations and up to 20 recommendation explanations are stored only on this device, excluded from backup. Disabling sleep suggestions or removing saved summaries removes this baseline and history.

These summaries are for personal tracking and are not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
